description: A script whose only top-level statement is `IO.puts("a")` fails with lower/unbound. Found while working fz-sc8.41; it is not that ticket's cause. Probe on interp, run and build against elixir, and find where the binding is lost. May overlap with fz-sc8.8 (IO.puts/1); check that ticket first and fold it in if it is the same cause.
title: A top-level IO.puts on its own compiles
